title: KnowledgeVIS: Interpreting Language Models by Comparing Fill-in-the-Blank Prompts

bias_targets.methodology: Substituting gendered noun and pronoun subjects into fill-in-the-blank prompt templates and visually analyzing the probability, ranking, and semantic clusters of predicted words.

Comparing language model predictions for LGBTQIA+ identity labels versus heterosexual/binary labels using visual analytics on fill-in-the-blank prompts to detect stereotypical or negative associations.

Replacing subjects with different racial and ethnic group names (e.g., Asian Americans, African Americans, Hispanic and Latino Americans) in prompt templates and evaluating the predicted tokens for negative stereotypes.
Testing fill-in-the-blank sentences with various religious identities (e.g., Islam, Judaism, Atheism) to uncover biased attributes, moral judgments, and affiliations via visual clustering.
Substituting political ideologies (e.g., Communism, Liberalism, Fascism) into prompts to visualize and compare shared semantic qualities and stereotypical associations in model predictions.
